newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Skandia '96 profit seen at 3.06 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Skandia '96 profit seen at 3.06 bln SKR.

text.p: Swedish insurer Skandia's pre-tax profit for 1996 was expected to be 3.06 billion crowns against 512 million crowns in 1995, a Reuter poll of eight analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts varied from 2.12 billion crowns to 3.97 billion.
Four of the analysts forecast Skandia's operating profit at an average of 4.11 billion crowns with estimates ranging from 3.24 billion to 4.79 billion crowns.
Skandia's operating profit in 1995 was 541 million crowns.
The average forecast was for a dividend payment of 3.15 crowns in 1996 against 2.00 crowns in 1995.
Analysts polled were from Fiba Nordic, Ohman, Swedbank, Penser, S-E-Banken, Aros, Handelsbanken, Carnegie and Nordbanken.
Skandia will release its annual earnings on March 5.
